items.title: Mobile AI Factory: Building Specialized Language Models for Your Mobile Device
items.summary: Small language models (SLMs) running on mobile devices can keep user data private and work without connectivity. But they perform well only when fine-tuned for the target task and sized for the target device, a process that today requires repeated expert tuning. We present {\it Mobile AI Factory}, an agentic system that builds a fine-tuned, quantized SLM for a given task and phone. Given a task specification and a target phone, an orchestrator LLM chooses whether to tune hyperparameters, mine real data, or generate synthetic examples, while fixed rules roll back changes that hurt accuracy. items.summary: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. items.title: Do Underwater Image Quality Metrics Agree with Human Perception? A Benchmark with Human Choices, Simple Edits and Generative Drift
items.summary: Underwater image enhancement is challenging to evaluate due to the lack of clean reference images, so researchers rely on no-reference image quality assessment (NR-IQA) metrics. However, it remains unclear whether these metrics agree with human judgments. We evaluate 73 handcrafted underwater, learned underwater, vision-language and general-purpose metrics against human preferences on five references: four published opinion-score sets and a new paired-comparison study. items.title: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
items.summary: Controllable real-world video generation models can condition on a rendered graybox proxy video, which fixes layout, motion and camera. Coding agents can build such videos by reconstructing a 4D scene in Blender, yet no benchmark checks both these videos and the long, multi-shot scenes behind them. We introduce VibePrevisBench, a benchmark for 4D scene reconstruction: an agent turns a brief into an executable 4D scene and renders its proxy video. Its 242 tasks span four input kinds, including scripts, photos, continuations, and reference videos. Each delivery is scored along two evaluation dim…

items.title: Evidence-Governed Adoption of Self-Generated Updates in Autonomous AI Agents
items.summary: Autonomous agents modify prompts, memories, tools, workflows, and policies using interaction histories. Yet a plausible modification is not necessarily suitable for persistent adoption: candidate selection is adaptive, evaluators may be imperfect, and local gains can hide degradation against an earlier baseline. We introduce Evidence-Governed Evolution (EGE), a framework for governing adoption of self-generated agent modifications. items.title: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens for parallel verification by a target model. Diffusion drafters such as DFlash propose an entire token block in a single forward pass, but mainly focus on text-only tasks, leaving multimodal drafting underexplored. To study this setting, we first introduce a metric of token-level visual dependence based on the KL divergence between next-token distributions with and without visual input. items.title: JFinBench: A Continuously Refreshable Japanese Financial Benchmark from the Latest Certification Exams
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to finance, creating a need for benchmarks that evaluate their capabilities across financial systems with different regulations and practices. However, existing financial benchmarks provide limited coverage of country-specific financial systems, and they are difficult to keep up to date as released questions leak into training data. We introduce JFinBench, a Japanese financial benchmark comprising 321 examples from the 2026 editions of six regularly administered certification exams covering accounting, tax, financial planning, and banking. …

items.title: eDIAR: Training-Free Open-Speaker Streaming Diarization for Long Meetings and Large Archives via e-means
items.summary: Meetings last up to an hour, and nobody knows in advance how many people will speak. Neural diarizers with a fixed number of output slots, such as Streaming Sortformer and Nemotron-3, are accurate and run online, but they cannot name more speakers than they have slots. We remove this limit without retraining. The slot head keeps deciding who is active and when speech overlaps, and speaker embeddings are clustered inside a single slot, with the official e-means algorithm, only after every slot has been used. items.title: Disen-Forcing: Disentangling Semantic Anchoring from Motion for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
items.summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models (AR-VDMs) enable real-time, long-horizon video generation but degrade rapidly once the inference horizon outruns the training horizon, due to compounding exposure bias. items.summary: Direct diffusion modeling of high-dimensional raw video data is challenging, and existing pixel-space methods often rely on specialized architectures. We introduce JVT (Just Video Transformer), a simple large-patch DiT-style Transformer for pixel-space video diffusion, without a pretrained autoencoder, auxiliary detailers, cascaded stages, or U-Net-style skip connections. items.summary: Previous work has shown that alignment training on individual LLM agents can fail to transfer to multi-agent settings. We investigate the underlying mechanisms for this failure, and explore interventions to preserve alignment transfer to multi-agent LLM teams. items.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
items.summary: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. items.summary: Open driving releases and usage-based insurance programs often claim to prevent privacy breaches by omitting GPS records when sharing or collecting vehicle data. However, removing GPS coordinates from driving logs does not erase the location information carried by vehicle signals. items.title: MEM-SQL: Memory-Empowered Text-to-SQL
items.summary: Text-to-SQL systems translate natural language questions into SQL queries over increasingly complex databases. However, widely used benchmarks evaluate questions independently, overlooking settings where earlier queries over the same database can supply joins or calculations for a new question. We introduce HARE (History-AwaRe Text-to-SQL BEnchmark) to measure the accuracy and cost of adapting historical SQL. items.title: AI Reviews Are Biased Towards the Appendix
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by reviewers to highlight weaknesses during the reviewing process, and their outputs often shape the reviews that humans submit. Prior work studies how LLM reviews align with human ones, yet we know little about which parts of a paper these models actually criticize. In this work, we investigate 2,000 papers from ACL, EMNLP, COLM, and ICLR, and show that the latest GPT and Claude models draw about 50% or more of their review weaknesses from the appendix. items.summary: The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks. Instead of training a dedicated policy for each family of tasks, an agentic robotic system applies a foundation model to open-world embodied tasks. items.summary: Recent advancements in multimodal diffusion language models (MDLMs) have exhibited strong global modeling capabilities through iterative refinement. We observe that mask uncertainty follows an overall downward trend during iterative denoising, while a few denoising steps exhibit localized entropy spikes closely associated with hallucinations. items.title: GH-AWTrace: A Large-Scale Dataset of GitHub Agentic Workflow Execution Logs
items.summary: Agentic workflows enable AI agents to perform recurring repository tasks on schedules or in response to repository events. Existing studies examine workflow definitions and outputs, but provide limited evidence of what happens during execution. We present GH-AWTrace, a dataset linking 25,014 verified GitHub Agentic Workflows across 5,051 repositories to 4,112,526 run records and 562,877 nonempty execution log archives. items.title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
items.summary: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. items.title: HALO: Human-Aligned Data Collection for WhoLe-body MObile Manipulation
items.summary: Learning whole-body mobile manipulation requires demonstrations that coordinate bimanual actions with locomotion across extended workspaces. However, existing interfaces trade off direct robot control, perception and action alignment, and natural operator mobility, making such demonstrations difficult to collect. We introduce HALO, a human-aligned data collection system for whole-body mobile manipulation. items.summary: Looped Transformers reduce parameter count by repeatedly applying shared blocks, but parameter sharing alone does not determine how the results of repeated computation are reused. items.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
items.summary: Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. items.title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
items.summary: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that organizes heterogeneous demonstrations through semantically corresponding observation and action modalities. items.title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
items.summary: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. items.summary: Monitoring maritime activities is important for safety and security, particularly for detecting illegal activities, but remains challenging due to the size and complexity of the maritime domain. The Automatic Identification System (AIS) is commonly used for this purpose, despite its known vulnerabilities. items.title: FETTUCCINE: Fast and efficient brain-to-text decoding on mobile devices
items.summary: Recent advances in speech neuroprostheses have enabled new communication avenues for people who have lost the ability to speak due to neurological illness or injury. These systems can decode neural activity during attempted speech into text by relying on language priors to achieve high decoding accuracy. This performance currently comes at the cost of using a compute-intensive language modeling stack, presenting a major bottleneck for real-world use. items.summary: Robot-use agents (RUAs) have emerged as a promising approach to general-purpose robot control. items.summary: Learning semantically meaningful human movement representations from 3D pose sequences is essential for human behavior modeling. items.summary: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. items.summary: Distilling diffusion models into few-step student models substantially reduces sampling latency, but induces severe diversity collapse: samples generated from different random seeds show minimal variation. items.summary: Demonstrations are an effective way to accelerate single-agent reinforcement learning (RL), but extending this idea to multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is non-trivial as it is difficult and often impossible for a single person to teleoperate multiple agents simultaneously. items.summary: An information system often has to learn before it knows what it will be asked. items.summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on a harness, the scaffold around the model that decides what it sees of its own interaction and what guidance it receives. Most existing approaches train under a hand-written harness that stays fixed throughout. However, an effective harness depends on the domain, the data and the model, and keeps changing as the model trains. items.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are expected to complete tasks while following rules of conduct, but these objectives can conflict. items.summary: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) can classify images using background-dominated patches that contain little or none of the target object, showing that they exploit contextual information. items.summary: 企业把大模型接进产品之后，新的经营问题才刚刚展开。客户提出一项任务，系统能拿到哪些信息，由谁核准结果，出现例外时如何处理，都会影响AI能否持续投入使用。产品演示中的能力，需要经由完整的服务过程才能转化为客户价值。 王强宇出任百望股份首席执行官（CEO），为观察这项变化提供了一个具体切口：王强宇如何将百望的财税场景积累转化为专业模型与智能体产品，并让研发、交付和组织能力共同支撑商业化。 产品的交付单位开始发生变化 在传统软件服务中，功能上线、接口联通与流程配置，是重要的交付内容。AI进一步参与工作后，客户会关心一次任务能否可靠完成，以及整个过程需要多少人工干预。 以交易核对为例，系统可能要在授权范围内读取发票、合同和付款记录，找到差异，列出依据，再把需要确认的事项交给相关岗位。对客户而言，价值取决于问题是否被准确识别、后续处理是否顺畅，以及投入的时间是否减少。 这改变了产品设计的起点。团队需要明确服务哪类任务、满足什么条件可以执行、哪些情况应当停止或转交人工。模型、数据、工具和复核机制，需要围绕同一项任务组合。 百望已推出AI财税专家团，在开票、记账和申报等服务中引入自然语言交互、标准化任务执行，并保留规则校验与人工确认。 沿着这一方向向更复杂的财税业务深入，可靠完成任务的能力将变得更加重要。 这也是王强宇出任CEO值得关注的原因。产品服务范围扩大之后，研发投入、客户承诺和交付保障之…

items.title: 其实我个人也是比较偏向于使用国模的，但问题是
items.summary: 其实我个人也是比较偏向于使用国模的，但问题是： - 要不像 deepseek 这种没有订阅的，使用起来其实非常昂贵的，你用 flash, 一天很容易烧掉 100 块 - 要不像 GLM 这种的，在模型能力不行的情况下（最近降智特别严重），同时还慢、贵，现在 GLM 5.5 更是难产 - 要不像 KIMI 这种的，模型能力不错，但是更贵、更慢、输入输出不透明 - 其它的就是一坨 我当然不想用国外的模型，因为同样恶心： - gpt 之前经常重置，但是使用政策朝令夕改，模型降智那也是常有的事，也就发布之初使用体验最好 - claude 使用起来最为稳定，但是仇视中国人，疯狂封号，使用之外的事情非常折腾，而且也是如履薄冰 - gemini 被戏称北美豆包，从去年 12 月份起， antigravity 到今年 9 月份才勉强能用，多少人被 gemini 3 pro 的刷分和 pro 半价订阅骗去订阅了 说到底，用户只想用高性价比的模型，不要求你能力最高，但是也不能在模型能力不足的同时，价格还要赶超吧？ 而且是在国内消费能力明显比米国低的情况下！ 贵而好、便宜单一般、又贵又不好，用户会用脚投票

items.title: 路上天天都能遇到焊颈帝
items.summary: 提车半年，每天通勤 13 公里，早上 5 公里，晚上走高架 8 公里，虽说晚上距离远点而且上海南北高架很堵，但是开起来都比早上轻松太多了... 几乎每天路上都能遇到电动车和自行车乱骑的，转弯回头观察也不会，电动车转向灯也没有，反正就是突然就要顶你车头前面转弯... 早上又遇到一个大妈，我直行过 T 字路口速度降低到 20 就是怕电动车来个转弯，果不其然大妈一个左转直接顶我车头前面，给我吓得一把方向加急刹才停下，大妈挡风被贴着车屁股过去了，更恶心的是我到公司翻看记录仪，我后车也遇到了 A 柱盲区的电动车，我车刚停下电动车就往我车屁股和他车头的缝里钻，他刚起步又是一脚急刹，估计也是吓坏了... 碰到了机动车高低是个次责，和同事吐槽，同事说被判过次责，电动车主责赔了 1000 补漆钱，然后他次责赔了 2000 去医院检查... 真是太抽象了...

items.title: 又被淘宝双 11 背刺了
items.summary: 因为准备玩 GTA6，双 11 期间在淘宝买了一台新电视，价格 4200+，买的时候宣传**“全网保价至 11 月 20 日”**，所以也没害怕会降价，就下单了。 结果没过几天，发现拼兮兮同款便宜了 400+。申请保价时，淘宝却说**必须在签收后 7 天内申请，超期不支持。** ？？？ 宣传时大字写着保价到 11 月 20 日，真要申请了，又搬出一个“签收后 7 天”的限制。 **那所谓的全网保价，到底保了个什么？** ### 更离谱的还在后面！ 因为不认可处理结果，我通过 12315 正式投诉。 淘宝只是打电话通知我不给退差价，我明确没有接受这个方案，也没有同意和解。 结果 12315 的处理反馈居然显示： **「和解结果：协商和解成功」** ？？？？？？ **没退款、没达成一致、我也没同意，怎么就“和解成功”了？** 难道现在的协商和解，只需要平台打个电话单方面通知，就算成功？ 几百块钱是小事，但平台宣传的承诺算不算数？消费者没认可的处理方案，凭什么叫“和解成功”？ **双 11 的套路越来越多，现在连投诉都能被“成功和解”了？** 之前双十一也遇到过这种类似的情况，12315 投诉以后没超过三天就把差价退了，现在真是呵呵了， 可能我年纪大了，我也 out 了 所以以后不打算在淘宝买大件了，体检都很不好
